member.name: T:SysWeaver.Chat.ChatDataViews
member.summary:
Build 's from the data urls, using the extension viewers / editors of the ().
The heuristic (see ) separates two kinds of links:
Files (a document, a data file, a report the AI made, an upload): shown in the extension viewer of the file type when one exists, with a source view (the read only extension editor) when that is something else than the viewer.
Live links (an application page such as a table, a chart or the api explorer, an api call, anything with a query or a fragment): shown as they are (the page is the view), never with a source view (the page template or the request means nothing to the reader).
An html page is only treated as a file when it is user / chat content (the chat files, the user storage); every other html page of the site is an application page. Other file types are files unless they are an api call.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.Chat.ChatDataViews.GetOne(SysWeaver.MicroService.ServiceManager,System.String,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{System.String})
member.summary:
Get the view of one data url:
Other origins, site absolute, data: and blob: urls: the raw url only (chat page relative urls without "../" are files of the chat).
No file extension (an api call, a folder): the raw url only.
An api call (a path with an "Api" folder, ex: "../chat/Api/GetFile.json?..."): the raw url only.
Html: a live link (a query or a fragment, ex: "../explore/table.html?q=...") or an html page of the site that isn't user / chat content (an application page, ex: "../chart/Chart.html") is shown as it is, without a source view. User / chat content (a document) uses the extension viewer of html with "sandbox=0" (the page runs with this site's origin, so the files and apis it uses work; when there is no viewer it's shown as it is) and gets a source view.
Images (svg and raster): a static image uses its extension viewer (when there is one, else it's shown as an image), a static svg also gets a source view; a generated image (a query) is shown as an image.
Other files: the extension viewer (or else the read only extension editor) if one exists; a static file (no query or fragment) also gets the read only extension editor as a source view, when that is something else than the viewer.
member.param: The service manager.
The raw (chat page relative) url.
The site root relative url prefixes of user / chat content (lower case, see ).
member.returns: The view.
